entities.name: Query DHH pyrophosphatase
observations: 322 aa soluble protein with tandem DHH (PF01368) and DHHA2 (PF02833) domains.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt O29502 from Archaeoglobus fulgidus, annotated as probable manganese-dependent inorganic pyrophosphatase.
Curated homologs support binding two Mn2+ ions per subunit and EC 3.6.1.1 activity.

entities.name: O29502
observations: Reviewed Archaeoglobus fulgidus protein with exact sequence identity to the query; annotated as probable manganese-dependent inorganic pyrophosphatase.
Cytoplasmic enzyme; binds two Mn2+ ions per subunit.

entities.name: Diphosphate hydrolysis
observations: EC 3.6.1.1; Rhea RHEA:24576: diphosphate + H2O = 2 phosphate + H+.

entities.name: Manganese cofactor
observations: The enzyme binds two Mn2+ ions per subunit; manganese is the curated metal cofactor for this DHH-family pyrophosphatase.
